resolution.note: limit_hit counts only claude-reported errors; regression test: a successful arm quoting a limit is not delayed or retried

title: A D23 arm whose output mentions a usage limit is not treated as limit-hit
body:
Why: in the n100 run (2026-11-12) arm 622.P succeeded, but its result text quoted its own task ("hit your 5-hour limit"); replay.sh limit_hit greps the whole claude.json and stderr, so the arm slept the 5 h cap and would be retried and rerun by the driver.
Outcome: an arm counts as limit-hit only when claude reports an error (claude.json is_error true, or no parseable json) and the error text names a usage limit; a successful arm whose output mentions limits is never retried.
Proof: a replay test with a fake claude that succeeds with a result mentioning "hit your 5-hour limit" asserts no wait, no retry and no limit_retry line.
Scope: evals/d23/, test/evals/.
